sources.summary: Festival des Architectures Vives 2027 in Montpellier: Call for Applications The Festival des Architectures Vives (FAV) has launched its call for applications for its 21st edition, taking place in Montpellier, France, from 15 to 20 June 2027. Under the theme “Shared Happiness”, the festival invites young professionals in architecture, landscape architecture, urban planning and related disciplines to design temporary installations for the historic courtyards of Montpellier’s private mansions. Applications are open until 7 December 2026.
